title: PNAS Nexus: Multidisciplinary convergence in the pursuit of useful purposes
content: In his treatise on the nature of technology in 2009, W. Brian Arthur provided a simple and elegant definition of technology: “leveraging phenomena for useful purposes” (1). I have used and expanded this definition in a number of dimensions: 1) by categorizing the hierarchy of phenomena in terms of complexity, from physical, to chemical, to biological, and ultimately, to social; 2) by expanding phenomena to include systems, devices, tools, and combinations thereof; and 3) by including scientific discovery and the solution of grand challenge–like problems in the category of useful purposes.
